scope: Advance original NTFS inspection with post-fixup resident/nonresident attribute envelopes and finite mapping-pair iteration. No attribute-list extension joining, payload-specific interpretation, decompression/decryption, namespace/content traversal, native source/provider/frontend or effect admission follows.
ownership: Private C90 attribute.c and runlist.c extend portable/ntfs/ntfs.h and reuse DE-W076 restoration/checked arithmetic. Caller-owned buffers/cursors; no heap, callback, native I/O, C struct serialization or public ABI. API/control/result objects are valid, disjoint and stable; this is not a hostile C-caller boundary.
record_cursor: Begin validates original protected FILE bytes and an explicit1..4096 item budget before restoring into a separate caller-owned RAM buffer. Invalid record/version/budget/capacity/overlap preserves source, destination and cursor. Cursor borrows only the restored used-byte span and starts at its validated first-attribute offset. Restored bytes stay stable/read-only for traversal. Begin does not claim that attribute contents are valid.
iteration: Read DWORD end markerFFFFFFFF only when four bytes remain; stop there and ignore later slack. Preserve common type/length/form/name/flags/instance fields. Declared record length is at least16, aligned8 and inside the remaining used span. A safely bounded length can advance past a malformed/unsupported variant while preserving issues; an unsafe length/truncation stops without inventing the next entry. Missing end marker and item budget exhaustion are explicit stopped-prefix diagnostics. A subsequent call after termination/stop returns DE_EMPTY with cursor/result unchanged. End-marker observation does not prove instance uniqueness, sorting, payload validity or complete logical streams.
resident: Require24-byte variant header. Name is original UTF16LE units; when name length is zero its offset is undefined and ignored. Nonempty name and value spans are bounded after the variant header and mutually disjoint; do not invent extra alignment rules for those byte offsets. Empty resident value may have offset0..record_length and exposes no header bytes as content. Preserve resident flags/reserved bytes and raw value bytes without payload interpretation or display normalization.
nonresident: Require64-byte header; first segment of a compressed or sparse stream additionally requires72 bytes and observes total allocation. Continuation sizes are raw/undefined, not current stream-size assertions. Preserve lowest/highest VCN, mapping offset, raw compression unit and size counters. Applicable on-disk sizes and VCN coordinates are nonnegative signed64 values; retain raw high-bit patterns but diagnose them instead of declaring a usable envelope. For first segments require initialized<=data, and ordinary uncompressed/nonsparse data<=allocated; do not impose ordinary allocation relationships on compressed/sparse/unknown features. Empty first stream uses lowest0/highestFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and zero counters, including an applicable total allocation. Otherwise require a representable inclusive VCN span. Mapping bytes start after the chosen header and any name, with at least one byte available. Unknown types/flags and compressed/encrypted content remain explicit unsupported observations; no decompression or encrypted-content interpretation.
run_cursor: Begin accepts bounded mapping bytes, explicit first VCN/count/volume-cluster bound, a0/1 sparse selector and1..4096 run budget. Validate parameters and checked end VCN before changing the cursor. Every run has a1..8-byte positive signed length and0..8-byte signed LCN delta. Decode sign through existing unsigned limb operations; no native64, signed overflow or unchecked shifts. The selected interoperable profile refuses a length whose encoded sign bit is set, while preserving raw diagnostics. Offset-width0 is a sparse run; nonzero width and resulting LCN0 is mapped data. Sparse runs leave previous LCN unchanged. Negative deltas cannot underflow; mapped end clusters and VCN progression cannot overflow or exceed supplied bounds.
termination: Only zero header byte terminates mapping pairs. Require exact requested VCN coverage at that terminator. Extra encoded runs, missing terminator, zero/negative length, invalid widths, short bytes, forbidden sparse runs, arithmetic/range failures and budgets retain valid prefixes and explicit issues; do not truncate, clamp, retry or fabricate mappings. Terminal/stopped calls return DE_EMPTY unchanged. Run decoding proves bounded encoded observations, not allocation ownership, complete stream content or source freshness.
reconciliation: Microsoft's mapping prose, the pinned kernel reader and NTFS-3G differ about length interpretation, zero LCN and legacy sparse sentinels. Select positive signed canonical lengths (Microsoft/NTFS-3G), explicit zero-width sparse encoding, and mapped LCN zero when width is nonzero. Do not import the kernel's zero-delta refusal or treat an explicit negative final LCN as an admitted mapping. Applicable attribute-header signed fields must be checked before producing stream tuples; the standalone checked run cursor can inspect explicit unsigned coordinate/bound tuples but grants no NTFS format applicability. Preserve these compatibility limits; original full NTFS capability remains subject to later corpus/provider qualification. Initialized length is byte-granular; do not round it from prose into extra initialized data.
acceptance: Independent generated protected FILE records with resident/nonresident, named/unnamed, unknown/unsupported, continuation and empty attributes; all span boundaries, malformed lengths, missing/end-marker/slack, budgets, raw UTF16 names and counters. Actual post-fixup cross-stride attributes agree with original logical bytes.

Independent Python signed-byte/integer mapping oracle for positive/negative/zero deltas, mapped LCN0, sparse between mapped runs,1..8 widths, full requested coverage and all arithmetic/range/budget/terminator failures; noncanonical length signs and legacy sentinels stay diagnostic.

Actual readonly/guard input and restored buffers, invalid API/result/destination sentinels, stopped-state immutability and original boot/record regressions. No expected-output weakening or media access.
Exact native compiler/header/import/build-boundary and source/context/spec/tooling evidence. Untested platforms, provider/volume/content/writer, owner and full original0.1.0 remain unverified.
source_use: Functional format references only; independently authored implementation and fixtures. Upstream code is neither imported nor executed.
